note: This file is a pure configuration file (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines dataset settings, data loading pipelines, and evaluators for the Objects365v2 dataset in MMDetection. All values are variable assignments (dicts, lists, strings).
dataset_type: Objects365V2Dataset — dataset class identifier for MMDetection
data_root: data/Objects365/Obj365_v2/ — root path for dataset files
train_pipeline: Image augmentation pipeline: LoadImageFromFile → LoadAnnotations → Resize(1333x800) → RandomFlip → PackDetInputs
test_pipeline: Inference pipeline: LoadImageFromFile → Resize(1333x800) → LoadAnnotations → PackDetInputs (with meta_keys)
train_dataloader: Training dataloader config: batch_size=2, AspectRatioBatchSampler, filter_empty_gt=True, min_size=32
val_dataloader: Validation dataloader config: batch_size=1, no shuffle, test_mode=True
val_evaluator: CocoMetric evaluator using bbox metric on zhiyuan_objv2_val.json
